scenarios.name: The Grand Cotillion
scenarios.flavorText: A famous heiress has just come of age; suitors from every family of note have gathered to win her favor. Can you outmanuever your rivals to secure the debutante's hand?
scenarios.primaryObjective: Players gain one victory point for every round they dance with the debutante
scenarios.secondaryObjectives: Key tokens represent knowledge of the debutante's preferences. While adjacent to the debutante, spend 1 action to gain a key token. Each key token is worth 1 victory point at the end of the game.
scenarios.specialRules: Grand Cotillion Special Event: As an action, nobles adjacent to her may become the debutante's partner this round.

npcs.name: The Debutante
npcs.description: The debutante starts in one of the middle squares of the map.  She waits to be invited to dance.  If she is ever unpartnered, she moves directly toward the center of the map.

scenarios.name: Ballroom Breach
scenarios.flavorText: A scandal threatens the court. Use charm and grace to redirect attention before the hour is lost.
scenarios.primaryObjective: Collect victory points by controlling the social spotlight.
scenarios.secondaryObjectives: Gain bonus points for preserving influence over the most nobles.
scenarios.specialRules: NPC guards may interfere with dance patterns. Random events may force an unplanned duet.
scenarios.endConditions: Game ends after 6 rounds or when a faction reaches 12 victory points.

scenarios.name: Masquerade Mystery
scenarios.flavorText: Behind the masks, secrets unfold. Unravel the intrigue while maintaining your facade.
scenarios.primaryObjective: Discover and expose hidden alliances to gain victory points.
scenarios.secondaryObjectives: Secure personal favors from revealed nobles.
scenarios.specialRules: Masks conceal identities until challenged. Dance cards may reveal or hide information.
scenarios.endConditions: Game ends after 8 rounds or when all masks are removed.

npcs.name: The Masked Inquisitor
npcs.description: A mysterious figure probing for secrets, disrupting social harmony.
